column3: OPERATIVE PROCEDURE,1.  Thromboendarterectomy of right common, external, and internal carotid artery utilizing internal shunt and Dacron patch angioplasty closure.,2.  Coronary artery bypass grafting x3 utilizing left internal mammary artery to left anterior descending, and reverse autogenous saphenous vein graft to the obtuse marginal, posterior descending branch of the right coronary artery.  Total cardiopulmonary bypass,cold blood potassium cardioplegia, antegrade and retrograde, for myocardial protection, placement of temporary pacing wires.,DESCRIPTION:,  The patient was brought to the operating room, placed in supine position.  Adequate general endotracheal anesthesia was induced.  Appropriate monitoring lines were placed.  The chest, abdomen and legs were prepped and draped in a sterile fashion.  The greater saphenous vein was harvested from the right upper leg through interrupted skin incisions and was prepared by ligating all branches with 4-0 silk and flushing with vein solution.  The leg was closed with running 3-0 Dexon subcu, and running 4-0 Dexon subcuticular on the skin, and later wrapped.  A median sternotomy incision was made and the left internal mammary artery was dissected free from its takeoff at the subclavian to its bifurcation at the diaphragm and surrounded with papaverine-soaked gauze.  The sternum was closed.  A right carotid incision was made along the anterior border of the sternocleidomastoid muscle and carried down to and through the platysma.  The deep fascia was divided.  The facial vein was divided between clamps and tied with 2-0 silk.  The common carotid artery, takeoff of the external and internal carotid arteries were dissected free, with care taken to identify and preserve the hypoglossal and vagus nerves.  The common carotid artery was double-looped with umbilical tape, takeoff of the external was looped with a heavy silk, distal internal was double-looped with a heavy silk.  Shunts were prepared.  A patch was prepared.  Heparin 50 mg was given IV.  Clamp was placed on the beginning of the takeoff of the external and the proximal common carotid artery.  Distal internal was held with a forceps.  Internal carotid artery was opened with 11-blade.  Potts scissors were then used to extend the aortotomy through the lesion into good internal carotid artery beyond.  The shunt was placed and proximal and distal snares were tightened.  Endarterectomy was carried out under direct vision in the common carotid artery and the internal reaching a fine, feathery distal edge using eversion on the external.  All loose debris was removed and Dacron patch was then sutured in place with running 6-0 Prolene suture, removing the shunt just prior to completing the suture line.  Suture line was completed and the neck was packed.,The pericardium was opened.  A pericardial cradle was created.  The patient was heparinized for cardiopulmonary bypass, cannulated with a single aortic and single venous cannula.  A retrograde cardioplegia cannula was placed with a pursestring of 4-0 Prolene into the coronary sinus, and secured to a Rumel tourniquet.  An antegrade cardioplegia needle sump was placed in the ascending aorta and cardiopulmonary bypass was instituted.  The ascending aorta was cross-clamped and cold blood potassium cardioplegia was given antegrade, a total of 5 cc per kg.  This was followed sumping of the ascending aorta and retrograde cardioplegia, a total of 5 cc per kg to the coronary sinus.  The obtuse marginal 1 coronary was identified and opened, and an end-to-side anastomosis was then performed with running 7-0 Prolene suture.  The vein was cut to length.  Antegrade and retrograde cold blood potassium cardioplegia was given.  The obtuse marginal 2 was not felt to be suitable for bypass, therefore, the posterior descending of the right coronary was identified and opened, and an end-to-side anastomosis was then performed with running 7-0 Prolene suture to reverse autogenous saphenous vein.  The vein was cut to length.  The mammary was clipped distally, divided and spatulated for anastomosis.  Antegrade and retrograde cold blood potassium cardioplegia was given.  The anterior descending was identified and opened. the mammary was then sutured to this with running 8-0 Prolene suture.  Warm blood potassium cardioplegia was given, and the cross-clamp was removed.  A partial-occlusion clamp was placed.  Two aortotomies were made.  The veins were cut to fit these and sutured in place with running 5-0 Prolene suture.  The partial- occlusion clamp was removed.  All anastomoses were inspected and noted to be patent and dry.  Atrial and ventricular pacing wires were placed.  Ventilation was commenced.  The patient was fully warmed.  The patient was weaned from cardiopulmonary bypass and de-cannulated in a routine fashion.  Protamine was given.  Good hemostasis was noted.  A single mediastinal chest tube and bilateral pleural Blake drains were placed.  The sternum was closed with figure-of-eight stainless steel wire, the linea alba with figure-of-eight #1 Vicryl, the sternal fascia with running #1 Vicryl, the subcu with running 2-0 Dexon and the skin with a running 4-0 Dexon subcuticular stitch.

Bypass kardiopulmonal total, kardioplegia kalium darah dingin, antegrade dan retrograde, untuk perlindungan miokard, pemasangan kabel pacing sementara.,DESKRIPSI:, Pasien dibawa ke ruang operasi, ditempatkan dalam posisi terlentang.  Anestesi endotrakeal umum yang memadai telah diinduksi.  Jalur pemantauan yang sesuai ditempatkan.  Bagian dada, perut dan kaki dipersiapkan dan dibungkus secara steril.  Vena saphena mayor diambil dari kaki kanan atas melalui sayatan kulit yang terputus dan dibuat dengan mengikat semua cabang dengan sutra 4-0 dan membilasnya dengan larutan vena.  Kaki ditutup dengan lari subkutikul Dexon 3-0, dan lari subkutikul Dexon 4-0 pada kulit, kemudian dibalut.  Sayatan sternotomi median dibuat dan arteri mamaria interna kiri dibedah mulai dari lepas landasnya di subklavia hingga percabangannya di diafragma dan dikelilingi dengan kain kasa yang direndam papaverin.  Tulang dada ditutup.  Sayatan karotis kanan dibuat sepanjang batas anterior otot sternokleidomastoid dan dibawa ke bawah menuju platysma.  Fasia dalam terbagi.  Vena wajah dibagi antara klem dan diikat dengan sutra 2-0.  Arteri karotis komunis, lepas landas dari arteri karotis eksternal dan internal dibedah bebas, dengan hati-hati untuk mengidentifikasi dan melestarikan saraf hipoglosus dan vagus.  Arteri karotis komunis dilingkarkan ganda dengan pita pusar, lepas landas bagian luar dilingkarkan dengan sutra tebal, bagian dalam distal dilingkarkan ganda dengan sutra tebal.  Shunt telah disiapkan.  Sebuah tambalan telah disiapkan.  Heparin 50 mg diberikan IV.  Penjepit dipasang pada awal lepas landasnya arteri karotis komunis eksterna dan proksimal.  Bagian distal internal ditahan dengan forsep.  Arteri karotis interna dibuka dengan 11 bilah.  Gunting Potts kemudian digunakan untuk memperluas aortotomi melalui lesi ke dalam arteri karotis interna di luarnya.  Shunt dipasang dan jerat proksimal dan distal dikencangkan.  Endarterektomi dilakukan dengan penglihatan langsung pada arteri karotis komunis dan bagian dalam mencapai tepi distal yang halus dan berbulu menggunakan eversi pada bagian luar.  Semua serpihan lepas telah dihilangkan dan tambalan Dacron kemudian dijahit pada tempatnya dengan jahitan Prolene 6-0, melepaskan shunt sesaat sebelum menyelesaikan garis jahitan.  Garis jahitan telah selesai dan leher telah dikemas. Perikardium dibuka.  Tempat lahir perikardial telah dibuat.  Pasien menjalani heparinisasi untuk bypass kardiopulmonal, dikanulasi dengan kanula aorta dan vena tunggal.  Kanula kardioplegia retrograde ditempatkan dengan tali Prolene 4-0 ke dalam sinus koroner, dan diamankan ke tourniquet Rumel.  Tempat jarum kardioplegia antegrade ditempatkan di aorta asendens dan bypass kardiopulmoner dilakukan.  Aorta asendens diklem silang dan kardioplegia kalium darah dingin diberikan antegrade, total 5 cc per kg.  Ini diikuti dengan penjumlahan aorta asendens dan kardioplegia retrograde, sebanyak 5 cc per kg ke sinus koroner.  Koroner marginal 1 tumpul diidentifikasi dan dibuka, dan anastomosis ujung ke sisi kemudian dilakukan dengan jahitan Prolene 7-0.  Pembuluh darahnya dipotong memanjang.  Kardioplegia kalium darah dingin antegrade dan retrograde diberikan.  Marginal tumpul 2 dirasa tidak cocok untuk bypass, oleh karena itu, bagian posterior koroner kanan yang turun diidentifikasi dan dibuka, dan anastomosis ujung ke sisi kemudian dilakukan dengan jahitan Prolene 7-0 untuk membalikkan vena saphena autogenous.  Pembuluh darahnya dipotong memanjang.  Payudara dipotong distal, dibagi dan dispatula untuk anastomosis.  Kardioplegia kalium darah dingin antegrade dan retrograde diberikan.  Descending anterior diidentifikasi dan dibuka. payudara kemudian dijahit dengan jahitan Prolene 8-0.  Kardioplegia kalium darah hangat diberikan, dan penjepit silang dilepas.  Penjepit oklusi parsial dipasang.  Dua aortotomi dilakukan.  Pembuluh darah dipotong agar sesuai dan dijahit di tempatnya dengan running 5-0 Jahitan prolen.  Penjepit oklusi parsial telah dilepas.  Semua anastomosis diperiksa dan dicatat paten dan kering.  Kabel pacing atrium dan ventrikel dipasang.  Ventilasi dimulai.  Pasien dalam keadaan hangat sepenuhnya.  Pasien disapih dari bypass kardiopulmonal dan dekanulasi secara rutin.  Protamin diberikan.  Hemostasis yang baik dicatat.  Sebuah tabung dada mediastinum tunggal dan saluran drainase Blake pleura bilateral dipasang.  Tulang dada ditutup dengan kawat baja tahan karat berbentuk angka delapan, linea alba dengan Vicryl angka delapan #1, fasia tulang dada dengan Vicryl #1, subku dengan Dexon 2-0 dan kulit dengan jahitan subkutikuler Dexon 4-0.

Studi pencitraan pra operasi mengungkapkan kelainan yang disebutkan di atas. Setelah meninjau pertimbangan manajemen secara rinci dengan pasien dan istrinya, ia terpilih untuk melanjutkan seperti disebutkan di atas. Indikasi operasi, metode, potensi manfaat, risiko dan alternatif ditinjau. Pasien dan istrinya menyatakan pemahaman dan menyetujui untuk melanjutkan seperti di atas. TEMUAN OPERASI:, tonjolan disk L4-L5 dan L5-S1 dengan konfigurasi seperti yang diantisipasi dari studi pencitraan pra operasi. Penempatan sekrup pedikel tampak memuaskan dengan pembelian dan penempatan yang memuaskan di semua lokasi serta temuan yang memuaskan saat memeriksa saluran pedikel di setiap lokasi. Selain itu, semua sekrup pedikel distimulasi dengan temuan di atas ambang batas yang dicatat di semua lokasi. Kesesuaian dan posisi spacer tampak memuaskan. Pemantauan elektrofisiologi dilakukan sepanjang prosedur dan tetap stabil tanpa ada laporan perubahan yang tidak semestinya. DESKRIPSI OPERASI: Setelah mendapatkan identifikasi pasien yang tepat dan persetujuan sebelum operasi yang sesuai, pasien dibawa ke ruang operasi dengan tandu rumah sakit dalam posisi terlentang. Setelah induksi anestesi endotrakeal umum yang memuaskan dan penempatan peralatan pemantauan yang sesuai oleh Anestesiologi serta penempatan peralatan pemantauan elektrofisiologi oleh tim Neurologi, pasien dengan hati-hati diubah ke posisi tengkurap dan ditempatkan di atas meja Jackson yang empuk dengan bantalan tambahan yang sesuai ditempatkan sesuai kebutuhan. Daerah lumbosakral posterior pasien dibersihkan dan dicukur secara menyeluruh. Pasien kemudian digosok, dipersiapkan dan dibalut dengan cara biasa. Setelah infiltrasi lokal dengan lidokain 1% dan larutan epinefrin 1:200.000, dibuat sayatan kulit garis tengah posterior yang memanjang dari sekitar L3 ke aspek inferior sakrum. Diseksi dilanjutkan di garis tengah hingga setinggi fasia posterior. Retraktor penahan sendiri ditempatkan dan kemudian disesuaikan kembali sesuai kebutuhan. Fasia dibuka di garis tengah, dan diseksi subperiosteal standar kemudian dilakukan untuk mengekspos elemen posterior dan posterolateral dari L3-L4 ke sakrum secara bilateral dengan paparan lateral dilakukan ke aspek lateral dari proses transversal L4 dan L5 serta sakral alae secara bilateral. _____ dengan menyelesaikan pemaparan, dilakukan fiksasi sekrup pedikel dengan cara sebagai berikut. Sekrup ditempatkan secara sistematis di bagian ekor dan tengkorak. Lokasi masuk sekrup pedikel dipilih menggunakan penanda punggung standar dan panduan fluoroskopi sesuai kebutuhan. Bukaan kortikal dibuat di situs ini menggunakan duri kecil. Saluran pedikel kemudian disiapkan terlebih dahulu menggunakan alat pencari pedikel Lenke. Mereka kemudian diperiksa dan kemudian disadap menggunakan panduan fluoroskopi sesuai kebutuhan. Masing-masing lokasi "kurang dimanfaatkan" dan dikecam dengan temuan-temuan memuaskan seperti disebutkan di atas. Sekrup dengan dimensi berikut ditempatkan. Sekrup berdiameter 6,5 mm dipasang di semua lokasi. Pada S1, sekrup sepanjang 40 mm ditempatkan secara bilateral. Pada L5, sekrup dengan panjang 40 mm ditempatkan secara bilateral, dan pada L4, sekrup dengan panjang 40 mm ditempatkan secara bilateral dengan temuan seperti disebutkan di atas. Batang tersebut kemudian dibuat konturnya mulai dari sekrup L4 hingga sekrup S1 di sebelah kanan. Pengalih perhatian ditempatkan di sela L4-L5, dan sambungan diamankan untuk sementara. Dengan menggunakan duri batang korek api, sebuah palung kemudian dibuat dengan hati-hati sedikit di luar garis tengah lamin kiri meluas dari aspek kaudal ke aspek yang lebih kranial di tingkat foraminal. Ini berorientasi pada longitudinal. Palung transversal juga dibuat dengan hati-hati dari titik kranial palung longitudinal hingga aspek lateral pars terhadap tingkat foraminal yang sedikit kaudal terhadap pedikel L4. Palung ini diselesaikan hingga setinggi ligamen flavum menggunakan kuret bersudut kecil dan Kerrison rongeurs, dan bagian lamina ini bersama dengan proses artikular L4 inferior kemudian diangkat sebagai satu unit menggunakan rongeurs dan kuret. Aspek kranial dari proses artikular superior L5 kiri kemudian diangkat menggunakan duri kecil dan kuret bersudut serta Kerrison rongeurs. Laminotomi superior dilakukan dari lamina L5 kiri dan flavektomi kemudian dilakukan pada daerah dekompresi ini, bekerja dari kaudal ke kranial dan medial ke lateral, sekali lagi menggunakan kuret dan Kerrison rongeurs dengan visualisasi langsung. Dengan cara ini, aspek lateral kiri dari kantung teka yang melewati saraf tulang belakang L5 kiri dan keluar dari saraf tulang belakang L4 kiri serta aspek posterolateral dari ruang diskus terlihat. Vena epidural lokal dikoagulasi dengan bipolar dan dibagi. Gelfoam kemudian ditempatkan di area ini. Proses ini kemudian diulangi dengan cara yang sama

column1: Tiroidektomi total untuk penyakit gondok.  Gondok tiroid multinodular dengan gejala tekan dan nodul tiroid dominan bilateral terbukti jinak dengan aspirasi jarum halus.
column4: JUDUL OPERASI: ,Tiroidektomi total untuk penyakit gondok.,INDIKASI UNTUK OPERASI: ,Ini adalah seorang wanita berusia 41 tahun yang mencatat adanya penyakit gondok tiroid tekan dan gejala-gejala yang berkaitan dengannya yang ingin menjalani operasi.  Risiko, manfaat, alternatif prosedur didiskusikan secara rinci dengan pasien.  Resiko yang terjadi antara lain adalah anestesi, perdarahan, infeksi, cedera saraf, kelumpuhan pita suara, suara serak, kalsium rendah, kebutuhan suplementasi kalsium, kekambuhan tumor, kebutuhan pengobatan tambahan, kebutuhan obat tiroid, kelainan kosmetik, dan lain-lain.  Pasien memahami semua masalah ini dan mereka ingin melanjutkan.,DIAGNOSIS SEBELUMNYA: , Gondok tiroid multinodular dengan gejala tekan dan nodul tiroid dominan bilateral terbukti jinak dengan aspirasi jarum halus.,DIAGNOSIS PASCATOP: , Gondok tiroid multinodular dengan gejala tekan dan nodul tiroid dominan bilateral terbukti jinak dengan aspirasi jarum halus.,ANESTESIA: , Endotrakeal umum.,DETAIL PROSEDUR: , Setelah mengidentifikasi pasien, pasien ditempatkan terlentang di meja ruang operasi.  Setelah menetapkan anestesi umum melalui intubasi endotrakeal oral dengan tabung endotrakeal sistem pemantauan 6 Nerve Integrity.  Mata kemudian ditempel dengan Tegaderm.  Sistem pemantauan Integritas Saraf, tabung endotrakeal dipastikan bekerja dengan baik.  Pada dasarnya sayatan sepanjang 7 cm dilakukan pada lipatan kulit bagian bawah leher.  Lidokain 1% dengan epinefrin 1:100.000 diberikan.  Gulungan bahu diterapkan.  Pasien bersiap dan mengenakan pakaian yang steril.  Pisau 15 digunakan untuk membuat sayatan.  Flap subplatysmal masing-masing diangkat ke takik tiroid dan sternum.  Otot tali dipisahkan di garis tengah.  Saat kami kemudian menoleh ke sisi kiri di mana otot sternohyoid dipisahkan dari otot sternothyroid, terdapat massa tiroid yang sangat padat dan kokoh di sisi kiri.  Otot sternothyroid ditranseksi secara horizontal.  Prosedur serupa dilakukan pada sisi kanan. Perhatian kemudian dialihkan untuk mengidentifikasi trakea di garis tengah.  Vena di daerah ini dan daerah pretrakeal diikat dengan pisau bedah harmonis.  Selanjutnya, perhatian dialihkan untuk membedah kapsul lobus tiroid kiri.  Sekali lagi ini sifatnya sangat tegas.  Kutub tiroid superior dibedah pada arteri ketiga superior, vena, dan masing-masing pembuluh darah diikat dengan pisau bedah harmonis.  Kelenjar paratiroid inferior dan superior terlindungi.  Nervus laring rekuren ditemukan pada alur trakeoesofagus.  Ini telah berhenti sejak awal sebagai jalur di bawah arteri tiroid inferior ke cabang motorik anterior yang sangat kecil.  Hal ini diikuti secara superior.  Tingkat membran krikotiroid setelah visualisasi lengkap seluruh saraf, ligamen Berry ditranseksi dan saraf dilindungi dan kemudian kelenjar tiroid dibedah di atas trakea.  Tingkat piramidal yang menonjol juga diapresiasi dan dibedah. Perhatian kemudian dialihkan ke sisi kanan.  Ada sejumlah besar jaringan tiroid yang sangat kuat.  Beberapa nodul dihargai.  Dengan cara yang sama, kapsul itu dibedah.  Kelenjar paratiroid superior dan inferior dilindungi dan dipelihara.  Arteri dan vena tiroid superior diligasi satu per satu dengan pisau bedah harmonik dan arteri tiroid inferior kemudian diligasi dekat dengan kapsul kelenjar tiroid.  Setelah saraf laring rekuren diidentifikasi lagi pada sisi ini, saraf tersebut telah berhenti lebih awal sebelum mengalir di bawah arteri tiroid inferior.  Cabang motorik anterior kemudian sangat halus, hampir berfilamen dan distimulasi pada 0,5 miliampere, dibedah seluruhnya menuju membran krikotiroid dengan visualisasi lengkap.  Sejumlah kecil jaringan tertinggal di ligamen Berry saat sisa tiroid dibedah di atas trakea.  Seluruh spesimen tiroid kemudian diambil, ditandai dengan jahitan pada kutub superior.  Lukanya diirigasi secara melimpah, dilakukan manuver Valsalva, titik perdarahan terkontrol.  Kelenjar paratiroid tampaknya dapat hidup.  Kedua cabang motorik anterior yang kecil distimulasi pada 5 miliampere dan dipastikan bekerja dengan sistem pemantauan Integritas Saraf. Perhatian kemudian dialihkan untuk mengubur Surgicel di dasar luka di kedua sisi.  Otot tali didekati ulang di garis tengah menggunakan Vicryl s 3-0 Gambaran transeksi horizontal sternotiroid dan otot tali di garis tengah kemudian didekati ulang. Insertion of tissue expander to the lateral wound.,COMPLICATIONS: , None.,TOURNIQUET: , None.,ANESTHESIA:  ,General.,INDICATIONS: , This patient developed a compartment syndrome.  She underwent 4 compartment fasciotomy with dual incision on medial and lateral aspect of the right lower leg.  She was doing very well and was obviously improving.,The swelling was reduced.  A compartment pressure had obviously improved based on examination.  She was therefore indicated for placement of tissue expander for ventral wound closure.  The risks of procedure as well as alternatives of this procedure were discussed at length with the patient and he understood them well.  Risks and benefits were all discussed, risk of bleeding, infection, damage to blood vessels, damage to nerve roots, need for further surgery, chronic pain with range of motion, risk of continued discomfort, risk of need for further reconstructive procedures, risk of blood clots, pulmonary embolism, myocardial infarction, and risk of death were discussed.  She understood them well.  All questions were answered, and she signed the consent for the procedure as described.,DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCEDURE:,  The patient was placed on the operating table and general anesthesia was achieved.  The medial wound was noted to be approximately 10.5 cm in length x 4 cm.  The lateral wound was noted in approximately 14 cm in length x 5 x 5 cm in width.  Both wounds were then thoroughly debrided.  The debridement of both wounds included skin and subcutaneous tissue and nonviable muscle portion.  This involve very small portion of muscle as well as skin edge and the subcutaneous tissue did require debridement on both sides.  At this point adequate debridement was performed and healthy tissue did appear to be present.  Initially on the medial wound I did place the DermaClose RC continuous external tissue expander.  On the medial wound the 5 skin anchors were placed on each side of the wound and separated appropriately.  I then did place the line loop from the tension controller in a lace like manner through the skin anchors and the tension controller was attached to the middle anchor.  I then did place adequate tension on the sutures.  Continued tension will be noted after engaging the tension controller.  At this point I performed the similar procedure to the lateral wound.  The skin anchors were placed separately and appropriately on either side of the skin margin.  The line loop from the tension controller was placed in lace like manner through the skin anchors.  The tension controller was then attached to the mid anchor and appropriate tension was applied.,It must be noted I did undermine the skin edges both sides of flap from both incision site prior to placement of the skin anchor and adequate mobilization was obtained.  Adequate tension was placed in this region.  A non thick dressing was then applied to the open-wound region and sterile dressing was then applied.  No complications were encountered throughout the procedure and the patient tolerated the procedure well.  The patient was taken to recovery room in stable condition.

column1: PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: , Thrombosed arteriovenous shunt left forearm.,POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS:  ,Thrombosed arteriovenous shunt, left forearm with venous anastomotic stenosis.,PROCEDURE:  ,Thrombectomy AV shunt, left forearm and patch angioplasty of the venous anastomosis.,ANESTHESIA: , Local.,SKIN PREP: , Betadine.,DRAINS: , None.,PROCEDURE TECHNIQUE:  ,The left arm was prepped and draped.  Xylocaine 1% was administered and a transverse antecubital incision was made over the venous limb of the graft, which was dissected out and encircled with a vessel loop.  The runoff vein was dissected out and encircled with the vessel loop as well.  A longitudinal incision was made over the venous anastomosis.  There was a narrowing in the area and slightly the incision was extended more proximally.  There was good back bleeding from the vein as well as bleeding from the more distal vein.  These were occluded with noncrushing DeBakey clamps and the patient was given 5000 units of heparin intravenously.  A #4 Fogarty was used to extract thrombus from the graft systematically until the arterial plug was removed and excellent inflow was established.  There was a narrowing in the mid portion of the venous limb of the graft, which was dilated with a #5 coronary dilator.  The Fogarty catheter was then passed up the vein, but no clot was obtained.  A patch PTFE material was fashioned and was sutured over the graftotomy with running 6-0 Gore-Tex suture.  Clamps were removed and flow established.  A thrill was easily palpable.  Hemostasis was achieved and the wound was irrigated and closed with 3-0 Vicryl subcutaneous suture followed by 4-0 nylon on the skin.  A sterile dressing was applied.  The patient was taken to the recovery room in satisfactory condition having tolerated the procedure well.  Sponge, instrument and needle counts were reported as correct.

Radiographic gastrostomy tube study with gastric contrast, interpretation.,ANESTHESIA: , General anesthesia.,INDICATIONS OF THE PROCEDURE: , The patient is a 47-year-old male with a history of chronic esophageal stricture who is admitted with food sticking and retching.  He has esophageal rupture on CT scan and comes now for a thoracotomy and gastrostomy.,DETAILS OF THE PROCEDURE: , After an extensive informed consent discussion process, the patient was brought to the operating room.  He was placed in a supine position on the operating table.  After induction of general anesthesia and placement of a double lumen endotracheal tube, he was turned and placed in a right lateral decubitus position on a beanbag with appropriate padding and axillary roll.  Left chest was prepped and draped in a usual sterile fashion.  After administration of intravenous antibiotics, a left thoracotomy incision was made, dissection was carried down to the subcutaneous tissues, muscle layers down to the fifth interspace.  The left lung was deflated and the pleural cavity entered.  The Finochietto retractor was used to help provide exposure.  The sixth rib was shingled in the posterior position and a careful expiration of the left pleural cavity was performed.,Immediately encountered was left pleural fluid including some purulent fluid.  Cultures of this were sampled and sent for microbiology analysis.  The left pleural space was then copiously irrigated.  A careful expiration demonstrated that the rupture appeared to be sealed.  There was crepitus within the mediastinal cavity.  The mediastinum was opened and explored and the esophagus was explored.  The tissues of the esophagus appeared to show some friability and an area of the rupture in the distal esophagus.  It was not possible to place any stitches in this tissue and instead a small intercostal flap was developed and placed to cover the area.  The area was copiously irrigated, this provided nice coverage and repair.  After final irrigation and inspection, two chest tubes were placed including a #36 French right angled tube at the diaphragm and a posterior straight #36 French.  These were secured at the left axillary line region at the skin level with #0-silk.,The intercostal sutures were used to close the chest wall with a #2 Vicryl sutures.  Muscle layers were closed with running #1 Vicryl sutures.  The wound was irrigated and the skin was closed with skin staples.,The patient was then turned and placed in a supine position.  A laparoscopic gastrostomy was performed and then a diagnostic laparoscopy performed.  A Veress needle was carefully inserted into the abdomen, pneumoperitoneum was established in the usual fashion, a bladeless 5-mm separator trocar was introduced.  The laparoscope was introduced.  A single additional left-sided separator trocar was introduced.  It was not possible to safely pass a nasogastric or orogastric tube, pass the stricture and perforation and so the nasogastric tube was left right at the level where there was some stricture or narrowing or resistance.  The stomach however did have some air insufflation and we were able to place our T-fasteners through the anterior abdominal wall and through the anterior gastric wall safely.  The skin incision was made and the gastric lumen was then accessed with the Seldinger technique.  Guide wire was introduced into the stomach lumen and series of dilators was then passed over the guide wire.  #18 French Gastrostomy was then passed into the stomach lumen and the balloon was inflated.  We confirmed that we were in the gastric lumen and the balloon was pulled up, creating apposition of the gastric wall and the anterior abdominal wall.  The T-fasteners were all crimped and secured into position.  As was in the plan, the gastrostomy was secured to the skin and into the tube.  Sterile dressing was applied. column1: PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS:,  Empyema.,POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: , Empyema.,PROCEDURE PERFORMED:,1.  Right thoracotomy, total decortication.,2.  Intraoperative bronchoscopy.,ANESTHESIA: , General.,COMPLICATIONS: , None.,ESTIMATED BLOOD LOSS:,  300 cc.,FLUIDS: , 2600 cc IV crystalloid.,URINE: , 300 cc intraoperatively.,INDICATIONS FOR PROCEDURE:  ,The patient is a 46-year-old Caucasian male who was admitted to ABCD Hospital since 08/14/03 with acute diagnosis of right pleural effusion.  A thoracostomy tube was placed at the bedside with only partial resolution of the pleural effusion.  On CT scan evaluation, there is evidence of an entrapped right lower lobe with loculations.  Decision was made to proceed with surgical intervention for a complete decortication and the patient understands the need for surgery and signed the preoperative informed consent.,OPERATIVE PROCEDURE: , The patient was taken to the operative suite and placed in the supine position under general anesthesia per Anesthesia Department.  Intraoperative bronchoscopy was performed by Dr. Y and evaluation of carina, left upper and lower lobes with segmental evidence of diffuse mucous, thick secretions which were thoroughly lavaged with sterile saline lavage.  Samples were obtained from both the left and the right subbronchiole segments for Gram stain cultures and ASP evaluation.  The right bronchus lower, middle, and upper were also examined and subsegmental bronchiole areas were thoroughly examined with no evidence of masses, lesions, or suspicious extrinsic compressions on the bronchi.  At this point, all mucous secretions were thoroughly irrigated and aspirated until the airways were clear.  Bronchoscope was then removed.  Vital signs remained stable throughout this portion of the procedure.  The patient was re-intubated by Anesthesia with a double lumen endotracheal tube.  At this point, the patient was repositioned in the left lateral decubitus position with protection of all pressure points and the table was extended in customary fashion.  At this point, the right chest was prepped and draped in the usual sterile fashion.  The chest tube was removed before prepping the patient and the prior thoracostomy site was cleansed thoroughly with Betadine.  The first port was placed through this incision intrathoracically.  A bronchoscope was placed for inspection of the intrathoracic cavity.  Pictures were taken.  There is extensive fibrinous exudate noted under parietal and visceral pleura, encompassing the lung surface, diaphragm, and the posterolateral aspect of the right thorax.  At this point, a second port site anteriorly was placed under direct visualization.  With the aid of the thoracoscopic view, a Yankauer resection device was placed in the thorax and blunt decortication was performed and aspiration of reminder of the pleural fluid.  Due to the gelatinous nature of the fibrinous exudate, there were areas of right upper lobe that adhered to the chest wall and the middle and lower lobes appeared entrapped.  Due to the extensive nature of the disease, decision was made to open the chest in a formal right thoracotomy fashion.  Incision was made.  The subcutaneous tissues were then electrocauterized down to the level of the latissimus dorsi, which was separated with electrocautery down to the anterior 6th rib space.  The chest cavity was entered with the right lung deflated per Anesthesia at our request.  Once the intrathoracic cavity was accessed, a thorough decortication was performed in meticulous systematic fashion starting with the right upper lobe, middle, and the right lower lobe.  With the expansion of the lung and reduction of the pleural surface fibrinous extubate, warm irrigation was used and the lungs allowed to re-expand.  There was no evidence of gross leakage or bleeding at the conclusion of surgery.,Full lung re-expansion was noted upon re-inflation of the lung.  Two #32 French thoracostomy tubes were placed, one anteriorly straight and one posteriorly on the diaphragmatic sulcus.  The chest tubes were secured in place with #0-silk sutures and placed on Pneumovac suction.  Next, the ribs were reapproximated with five interrupted CTX sutures and latissimus dorsi was then reapproximated with a running #2-0 Vicryl suture.  Next, subcutaneous skin was closed sequentially with a cosmetic layered subcutaneous closure.  Steri-Strips were applied along with sterile occlusive dressings.  The patient was awakened from anesthesia without difficulty and extubated in the operating room.  The chest tubes were maintained on Pleur-Evac suction for full re-expansion of the lung.  The patient was transported to the recovery with vital signs stable.  Stat portable chest x-ray is pending.  The patient will be admitted to the Intensive Care Unit for close monitoring overnight.

Bronkoskopi intraoperatif.,ANESTESIA: , Umum.,KOMPLIKASI: , Tidak ada.,PERKIRAAN KEHILANGAN DARAH:, 300 cc.,CAIRAN: , 2600 cc kristaloid IV.,URIN: , 300 cc intraoperatif.,INDIKASI PROSEDUR: ,Pasien adalah laki-laki bule berusia 46 tahun yang dirawat di Rumah Sakit ABCD sejak 14/08/03 dengan diagnosis akut efusi pleura kanan.  Sebuah tabung torakostomi ditempatkan di samping tempat tidur dengan hanya resolusi parsial dari efusi pleura.  Pada evaluasi CT scan, terdapat bukti adanya lobus kanan bawah yang terperangkap dengan lokulasi.  Keputusan dibuat untuk melanjutkan intervensi bedah untuk dekortikasi lengkap dan pasien memahami perlunya pembedahan dan menandatangani persetujuan sebelum operasi., PROSEDUR OPERASI:, Pasien dibawa ke ruang operasi dan ditempatkan dalam posisi terlentang di bawah anestesi umum per Departemen Anestesi.  Bronkoskopi intraoperatif dilakukan oleh Dr. Y dan evaluasi karina, lobus kiri atas dan bawah dengan bukti segmental dari lendir difus, sekret kental yang dibilas secara menyeluruh dengan lavage garam steril.  Sampel diperoleh dari segmen subbronkiol kiri dan kanan untuk kultur pewarnaan Gram dan evaluasi ASP.  Bronkus kanan bagian bawah, tengah, dan atas juga diperiksa dan area bronkiolus subsegmental diperiksa secara menyeluruh tanpa adanya bukti adanya massa, lesi, atau kompresi ekstrinsik yang mencurigakan pada bronkus.  Pada titik ini, seluruh sekret mukus diairi dan disedot secara menyeluruh sampai saluran pernafasan bersih.  Bronkoskop kemudian dilepas.  Tanda-tanda vital tetap stabil selama prosedur ini.  Pasien diintubasi ulang dengan Anestesi dengan tabung endotrakeal lumen ganda.  Pada titik ini, pasien diposisikan ulang pada posisi dekubitus lateral kiri dengan perlindungan semua titik tekanan dan meja direntangkan seperti biasa.  Pada titik ini, dada kanan telah dipersiapkan dan dibalut dengan cara steril seperti biasa.  Selang dada dilepas sebelum mempersiapkan pasien dan tempat torakostomi sebelumnya dibersihkan secara menyeluruh dengan Betadine.  Pelabuhan pertama ditempatkan melalui sayatan ini secara intratoraks.  Bronkoskop dipasang untuk memeriksa rongga intrathoracic.  Gambar telah diambil.  Terdapat eksudat fibrinosa yang luas di bawah pleura parietal dan visceral, meliputi permukaan paru, diafragma, dan aspek posterolateral dada kanan.  Pada titik ini, lokasi pelabuhan kedua di bagian anterior ditempatkan di bawah visualisasi langsung.  Dengan bantuan pandangan torakoskopi, alat reseksi Yankauer ditempatkan di dada dan dilakukan dekortikasi tumpul dan aspirasi untuk mengingatkan cairan pleura.  Karena sifat agar-agar dari eksudat fibrinosa, terdapat area lobus kanan atas yang menempel pada dinding dada dan lobus tengah dan bawah tampak terperangkap.  Karena sifat penyakitnya yang luas, keputusan dibuat untuk membuka dada dengan cara torakotomi kanan formal.  Sayatan dibuat.  Jaringan subkutan kemudian dielektrokauterisasi hingga setinggi latissimus dorsi, yang dipisahkan dengan elektrokauter hingga ke ruang rusuk ke-6 anterior.  Rongga dada dimasukkan dengan paru kanan dikempiskan per Anestesi atas permintaan kami.  Setelah rongga intratoraks diakses, dekortikasi menyeluruh dilakukan dengan cara sistematis yang cermat dimulai dari lobus kanan atas, tengah, dan lobus kanan bawah.  Dengan perluasan paru-paru dan pengurangan ekstubasi fibrinosa permukaan pleura, irigasi hangat digunakan dan paru-paru dibiarkan mengembang kembali.  Tidak ada bukti kebocoran besar atau perdarahan pada akhir operasi. Ekspansi paru penuh terlihat pada inflasi ulang paru.  Dua tabung torakostomi Perancis #32 dipasang, satu lurus di anterior dan satu lagi di posterior pada sulkus diafragma.  Selang dada dipasang pada tempatnya dengan jahitan sutra #0 dan dipasang pada penghisap Pneumovac.  Selanjutnya, tulang rusuk didekati ulang dengan lima jahitan CTX terputus dan latissimus dorsi kemudian didekati ulang dengan jahitan Vicryl #2-0.  Selanjutnya, kulit subkutan ditutup secara berurutan dengan penutupan subkutan berlapis kosmetik.  Steri-Strip diaplikasikan bersama dengan dressing oklusif steril.  Pasien terbangun dari anestesi tanpa kesulitan a dan diekstubasi di ruang operasi.  Selang dada dipertahankan pada pengisapan Pleur-Evac untuk ekspansi paru secara penuh.  Pasien dibawa ke tempat pemulihan dengan tanda-tanda vital stabil.  Stat rontgen dada portabel tertunda.  Pasien akan dirawat di Unit Perawatan Intensif untuk pemantauan ketat semalaman.

column2: POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: , Type 4 thoracoabdominal aneurysm.,OPERATION/PROCEDURE: , A 26-mm Dacron graft replacement of type 4 thoracoabdominal aneurysm from T10 to the bifurcation of the aorta, re-implanting the celiac, superior mesenteric artery and right renal as an island and the left renal as a 8-mm interposition Dacron graft, utilizing left heart bypass and cerebrospinal fluid drainage.,DESCRIPTION OF PROCEDURE IN DETAIL: , Patient was brought to the operating room and put in supine position, and general endotracheal anesthesia was induced through a double-lumen endotracheal tube.  Patient was placed in the thoracoabdominal position with the left chest up and the hips back to a 30-degree angle.  The left groin, abdominal and chest were prepped and draped in a sterile fashion.  A thoracoabdominal incision was made.  The 8th interspace was entered.  The costal margin was divided.  The retroperitoneal space was entered and bluntly dissected free to the psoas, bringing all the peritoneal contents to the midline, exposing the aorta.  The inferior pulmonary ligament was then taken down so the aorta could be dissected free at the T10 level just above the diaphragm.  It was dissected free circumferentially.  The aortic bifurcation was dissected free, dissecting free both iliac arteries.  The left inferior pulmonary vein was then dissected free, and a pursestring of 4-0 Prolene was placed on this.  The patient was heparinized.  Through a stab wound in the center of this, a right-angle venous cannula was then placed at the left atrium and secured to a Rumel tourniquet.  This was hooked to a venous inflow of left heart bypass machine.  A pursestring of 4-0 Prolene was placed on the aneurysm and through a stab wound in the center of this, an arterial cannula was placed and hooked to outflow.  Bypass was instituted.  The aneurysm was cross clamped just above T10 and also, cross clamped just below the diaphragm.  The area was divided at this point.  A 26-mm graft was then sutured in place with running 3-0 Prolene suture.  The graft was brought into the diaphragm.  Clamps were then placed on the iliacs, and the pump was shut off.  The aorta was opened longitudinally, going posterior between the left and right renal arteries, and it was completely transected at its bifurcation.  The SMA, celiac and right renal artery were then dissected free as a complete island, and the left renal was dissected free as a complete Carrell patch.  The island was laid in the graft for the visceral liner, and it was sutured in place with running 4-0 Prolene suture with pledgetted 4-0 Prolene sutures around the circumference.  The clamp was then moved below the visceral vessels, and the clamp on the chest was removed, re-establishing flow to the visceral vessels.  The graft was cut to fit the bifurcation and sutured in place with running 3-0 Prolene suture.  All clamps were removed, and flow was re-established.  An 8-mm graft was sutured end-to-end to the Carrell patch and to the left renal.  A partial-occlusion clamp was placed.  An area of graft was removed.  The end of the graft was cut to fit this and sutured in place with running Prolene suture.  The partial-occlusion clamp was removed.  Protamine was given.  Good hemostasis was noted.  The arterial cannula, of course, had been removed when that part of the aneurysm was removed.  The venous cannula was removed and oversewn with a 4-0 Prolene suture.  Good hemostasis was noted.  A 36 French posterior and a 32 French anterior chest tube were placed.  The ribs were closed with figure-of-eight #2 Vicryl.  The fascial layer was closed with running #1 Prolene, subcu with running 2-0 Dexon and the skin with running 4-0 Dexon subcuticular stitch.  Patient tolerated the procedure well.

column7: DIAGNOSIS PASCA OPERASI:, Aneurisma torakoabdominal tipe 4., OPERASI / PROSEDUR:, Penggantian cangkok Dacron 26 mm untuk aneurisma torakoabdominal tipe 4 dari T10 ke bifurkasi aorta, penanaman kembali arteri celiac, arteri mesenterika superior, dan ginjal kanan sebagai pulau dan ginjal kiri sebagai cangkok Dacron interposisi 8 mm, menggunakan bypass jantung kiri dan drainase cairan serebrospinal., DESKRIPSI PROSEDUR DETAIL: , Pasien dibawa ke ruang operasi dan dibaringkan dalam posisi terlentang, dan anestesi endotrakeal umum diinduksi melalui tabung endotrakeal lumen ganda.  Pasien dibaringkan dalam posisi thoracoabdominal dengan dada kiri menghadap ke atas dan pinggul kembali membentuk sudut 30 derajat.  Selangkangan kiri, perut dan dada dipersiapkan dan dibalut secara steril.  Sayatan torakoabdominal dibuat.  Ruang sela ke-8 telah dimasuki.  Margin kosta terbagi.  Ruang retroperitoneal dimasukkan dan dibedah secara tumpul hingga ke psoas, membawa seluruh isi peritoneal ke garis tengah, memperlihatkan aorta.  Ligamentum pulmonal inferior kemudian diturunkan sehingga aorta dapat dibedah bebas pada tingkat T10 tepat di atas diafragma.  Itu dibedah secara melingkar bebas.  Bifurkasi aorta dibedah bebas, membedah kedua arteri iliaka.  Vena pulmonalis inferior kiri kemudian dibedah bebas, dan dipasang tali pengikat Prolene 4-0 di atasnya.  Pasien menjalani heparinisasi.  Melalui luka tusuk di tengahnya, kanula vena sudut kanan kemudian ditempatkan di atrium kiri dan diamankan ke tourniquet Rumel.  Ini terkait dengan aliran masuk vena dari mesin bypass jantung kiri.  Sebuah pursestring Prolene 4-0 dipasang pada aneurisma dan melalui luka tusuk di tengahnya, kanula arteri dipasang dan dihubungkan ke aliran keluar.  Bypass dilembagakan.  Aneurisma diklem silang tepat di atas T10 dan juga diklem silang tepat di bawah diafragma.  Area tersebut terbagi pada saat ini.  Cangkok 26 mm kemudian dijahit dengan jahitan Prolene 3-0.  Cangkok dimasukkan ke dalam diafragma.  Klem kemudian dipasang pada iliaka, dan pompa dimatikan.  Aorta dibuka secara longitudinal, menuju posterior antara arteri ginjal kiri dan kanan, dan ditranseksi seluruhnya pada percabangannya.  Arteri SMA, seliaka, dan ginjal kanan kemudian dibedah bebas sebagai pulau lengkap, dan ginjal kiri dibedah bebas sebagai tambalan Carrell lengkap.  Pulau tersebut dimasukkan ke dalam cangkokan untuk pelapis visceral, dan dijahit di tempatnya dengan jahitan Prolene 4-0 dan jahitan Prolene 4-0 yang dipasang di sekeliling kelilingnya.  Penjepit kemudian dipindahkan ke bawah pembuluh darah visceral, dan penjepit di dada dilepas, sehingga aliran ke pembuluh darah visceral kembali lancar.  Cangkok dipotong agar sesuai dengan bifurkasi dan dijahit pada tempatnya dengan jahitan Prolene 3-0.  Semua klem dilepas, dan aliran kembali lancar.  Cangkok 8 mm dijahit ujung ke ujung pada patch Carrell dan ginjal kiri.  Penjepit oklusi parsial dipasang.  Area cangkokan telah dihilangkan.  Ujung cangkokan dipotong agar sesuai dan dijahit dengan jahitan Prolene.  Penjepit oklusi parsial telah dilepas.  Protamin diberikan.  Hemostasis yang baik dicatat.  Kanula arteri, tentu saja, telah diangkat ketika bagian aneurisma tersebut diangkat.  Kanula vena telah dilepas dan dijahit dengan jahitan Prolene 4-0.  Hemostasis yang baik dicatat.  Sebuah chest tube 36 French posterior dan 32 French chest tube dipasang.  Tulang rusuknya ditutup dengan Vicryl angka delapan #2.  Lapisan fasia ditutup dengan running #1 Prolene, subcu dengan running 2-0 Dexon dan kulit dengan jahitan subkutikular Dexon 4-0.  Pasien mentoleransi prosedur ini dengan baik.

column5: DIAGNOSA SEBELUM OPERASI: , Empiema dada, kiri.,DIAGNOSIS PASCA OPERASI: , Empiema dada, kiri.,PROSEDUR: , Torakotomi kiri dengan dekortikasi paru total dan pleurektomi parietal.,DETAIL PROSEDUR: , Setelah mendapatkan informed consent, pasien dibawa ke ruang operasi, di mana ia menjalani anestesi endotrakeal umum menggunakan lumen ganda tabung endotrakeal.  Proses time-out telah diikuti dan antibiotik pra operasi diberikan. Pasien diposisikan dengan sisi kiri menghadap ke atas untuk torakotomi kiri.  Pasien dipersiapkan dan dibungkus dengan cara biasa.  Torakotomi posterolateral dilakukan.  Itu termasuk sayatan sebelumnya.  Dada dimasukkan melalui ruang interkostal kelima.  Sebenarnya terdapat pleura parietal yang sangat kuat dan keras, yang pada awalnya tidak memungkinkan kami mendapatkan eksposur yang baik, dan ternyata lapisan tersebut sangat kuat sehingga pin retraktor dada putus.  Berkat kecerdikan Dr. X, kami dapat menggunakan kembali retraktor dada dan membuka dada setelah saya mengiris pleura parietal yang menebal sehingga mengakibatkan ledakan gas dan nanah dari rongga yang jelas-jelas dipenuhi oleh pleura parietal.  Kami menyedot banyak nanah dari rongga ini.  Sampel diambil untuk kultur dan sensitivitas.,Kemudian, setidaknya setengah jam dihabiskan untuk mencoba mengeksisi pleura parietal dan akhirnya kami dapat melakukannya hingga ke puncak dan kembali ke aorta __________ menuju jantung termasuk diafragmanya.  Setelah kami menyelesaikannya, kami melanjutkan untuk menghilangkan eksudat padat yang menempel di paru-paru.  Sampel lebih lanjut untuk kultur dan sensitivitas dikirim. Kemudian, kita dibiarkan dengan paru-paru yang terperangkap.  Itu terjebak oleh pleura visceral yang menebal.  Ini adalah bagian operasi yang paling sulit dan sangat sulit untuk mengangkat pleura parietal tanpa melukai paru-paru secara parah.  Akhirnya, kami dapat mencapai hal ini dan setelah lumen tabung endotrakeal yang sesuai dibuka, kami dapat menggembungkan lobus kiri atas dan bawah paru-paru dengan memuaskan.  Hanya ada satu area menuju mediastinum yang ternyata tidak bisa saya isi.  Area ini, tentu saja, sangat kaku tetapi operasi apa pun ke arah __________ akan menyebabkan __________ cedera, jadi saya menahan diri untuk tidak melakukannya.  Dua tabung dada besar dipasang.  Rongga tersebut telah banyak diairi dengan garam hangat.  Kemudian, torakotomi ditutup berlapis-lapis menggunakan jahitan tebal Vicryl sebagai jahitan perikostal dan kemudian beberapa jahitan terputus angka delapan pada lapisan otot dan kombinasi jahitan nilon dan staples pada kulit.,Tabung dada ditempelkan pada kulit dengan jahitan sutra tebal.  Dressing dipasang dan pasien dibaringkan kembali pada posisi terlentang dan setelah beberapa menit observasi dan evaluasi, ia dapat diekstubasi di ruang operasi. Diperkirakan kehilangan darah sekitar 500 mL.  Pasien mentoleransi prosedur ini dengan sangat baik dan dikirim ke ICU dalam kondisi memuaskan.

column1: PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: , Left mesothelioma, focal.,POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: , Left pleural-based nodule.,PROCEDURES PERFORMED:,1.  Left thoracoscopy.,2.  Left mini thoracotomy with resection of left pleural-based mass.,FINDINGS:,  Left anterior pleural-based nodule, which was on a thin pleural pedicle with no invasion into the chest wall.,FLUIDS: , 800 mL of crystalloid.,ESTIMATED BLOOD LOSS: , Minimal.,DRAINS, TUBES, CATHETERS: , 24-French chest tube in the left thorax plus Foley catheter.,SPECIMENS: , Left pleural-based nodule.,INDICATION FOR OPERATION:  ,The patient is a 59-year-old female with previous history of follicular thyroid cancer, approximately 40 years ago, status post resection with recurrence in the 1980s, who had a left pleural-based mass identified on chest x-ray.  Preoperative evaluation included a CT scan, which showed focal mass.  CT and PET confirmed anterior lesion.  Therefore the patient was seen in our thoracic tumor board where it was recommended to have resection performed with chest wall reconstruction.  In the outpatient setting, the patient was willing to proceed.,PROCEDURE PERFORMED IN DETAIL: , After informed consent was obtained, the patient identified correctly.  She was taken to the operating room where an epidural catheter was placed by Anesthesia without difficulty.  She was sedated and intubated with double-lumen endotracheal tube without difficulty.  She was positioned with left side up.  Appropriate pressure points were padded.  The left chest was prepped and draped in the standard surgical fashion.  The skin incision was made in the posterior axillary line, approximately 7th intercostal space with #10 blade, taken down through tissues and Bovie electrocautery.,Pleura was entered.  There was good deflation of the left lung.  __________ port was placed, followed by the 0-degree 10-mm scope with appropriate patient positioning.  Posteriorly a pedunculated 2.5 x 3-cm pleural-based mass was identified on the anterior chest wall.  There were thin adhesions to the pleura, but no invasion of the chest wall that could be identified.  The tumor was very mobile and was on a pedunculated stalk, approximately 1.5 cm.  It was felt that this could be resected without the need of chest wall reconstruction because of the narrow stalk.,Therefore a 2nd port was placed in the anterior axillary line approximately 8th intercostal space in the usual fashion.  Camera was placed through this port.  Laparoscopic scissors were placed through the posterior port, but it was necessary to have another instrument to provide more tension than just gravity.  Therefore because of the need to bring the specimen through the chest wall, a small 3-cm thoracotomy was made, which incorporated the posterior port site.  This was taken down to the subcutaneous tissue with Bovie electrocautery.  Periosteal elevator was used to lift the intercostal muscle off.  The ribs were not spread.  Through this 3-cm incision, both the laparoscopic scissors as well as Prestige graspers could be placed.  Prestige graspers were used to pull the specimen from the chest wall.  Care was taken not to injure the capsule.  The laparoscopic scissors on cautery were used to resect the parietal pleural off of the chest wall.  Care was taken not to transect the stalk.  Specimen came off the chest wall very easily.  There was good hemostasis.,At this point, the EndoCatch bag was placed through the incision.  Specimen was placed in the bag and then removed from the field.  There was good hemostasis.  Camera was removed.  A 24-French chest tube was placed through the anterior port and secured with 2-0 silk suture.  The posterior port site was closed 1st with 2-0 Vicryl in a running fashion for the intercostal muscle layer, followed by 2-0 closure of the latissimus fascia as well as subdermal suture, 4-0 Monocryl was used for the skin, followed by Steri-Strips and sterile drapes.  The patient tolerated the procedure well, was extubated in the operating room and returned to the recovery room in stable condition.

column6: DIAGNOSIS PRAOPERATIF: , Mesothelioma kiri, fokal.,DIAGNOSIS PASCA OPERASI: , Nodul berbasis pleura kiri.,PROSEDUR YANG DILAKUKAN:,1.  Torakoskopi kiri.,2.  Torakotomi mini kiri dengan reseksi massa berbasis pleura kiri.,TEMUAN:, Nodul berbasis pleura anterior kiri, yang berada pada pedikel pleura tipis tanpa invasi ke dinding dada.,CAIRAN: , 800 mL kristaloid.,PERKIRAAN KEHILANGAN DARAH: , Minimal.,DRAIN, TABUNG, KATHETER: , chest tube 24-French di thorax kiri plus Foley kateter.,SPESIMEN : , Nodul di dasar pleura kiri.,INDIKASI OPERASI : ,Pasien adalah seorang wanita berusia 59 tahun dengan riwayat kanker tiroid folikuler sebelumnya, kurang lebih 40 tahun yang lalu, status pasca reseksi dengan kekambuhan pada tahun 1980an, yang memiliki massa di dasar pleura kiri yang teridentifikasi pada rontgen dada.  Evaluasi pra operasi termasuk CT scan, yang menunjukkan massa fokus.  CT dan PET mengkonfirmasi lesi anterior.  Oleh karena itu pasien diperiksa di papan tumor toraks kami dan direkomendasikan untuk dilakukan reseksi dengan rekonstruksi dinding dada.  Dalam rawat jalan, pasien bersedia untuk melanjutkan., PROSEDUR DILAKUKAN SECARA DETAIL: , Setelah informed consent diperoleh, pasien mengidentifikasi dengan benar.  Dia dibawa ke ruang operasi di mana kateter epidural dipasang dengan anestesi tanpa kesulitan.  Dia dibius dan diintubasi dengan tabung endotrakeal lumen ganda tanpa kesulitan.  Dia diposisikan dengan sisi kiri menghadap ke atas.  Titik-titik tekanan yang sesuai diberi bantalan.  Dada kiri telah dipersiapkan dan dibungkus dengan cara bedah standar.  Sayatan kulit dibuat di garis aksila posterior, kira-kira ruang interkostal ke-7 dengan pisau #10, diturunkan melalui jaringan dan elektrokauter Bovie., Pleura dimasukkan.  Terdapat deflasi yang baik pada paru kiri.  Port __________ ditempatkan, diikuti oleh lingkup 0 derajat 10 mm dengan posisi pasien yang sesuai.  Di bagian posterior ditemukan massa berbasis pleura bertangkai berukuran 2,5 x 3 cm di dinding dada anterior.  Terdapat perlengketan tipis pada pleura, namun tidak ada invasi pada dinding dada yang dapat diidentifikasi.  Tumornya sangat mobile dan berada pada tangkai bertangkai, kira-kira berukuran 1,5 cm.  Hal ini dirasakan dapat direseksi tanpa memerlukan rekonstruksi dinding dada karena tangkainya yang sempit. Oleh karena itu, port ke-2 ditempatkan di garis aksila anterior kira-kira di ruang interkostal ke-8 dengan cara yang biasa.  Kamera ditempatkan melalui port ini.  Gunting laparoskopi ditempatkan melalui lubang posterior, tetapi diperlukan instrumen lain untuk memberikan tegangan lebih dari sekedar gravitasi.  Oleh karena itu karena kebutuhan untuk membawa spesimen melalui dinding dada, dilakukan torakotomi kecil berukuran 3 cm, yang mencakup lokasi port posterior.  Ini dibawa ke jaringan subkutan dengan elektrokauter Bovie.  Lift periosteal digunakan untuk mengangkat otot interkostal.  Tulang rusuknya tidak menyebar.  Melalui sayatan 3 cm ini, gunting laparoskopi dan alat genggam Prestige dapat dipasang.  Penggenggam prestise digunakan untuk menarik spesimen dari dinding dada.  Perawatan dilakukan agar tidak melukai kapsul.  Gunting laparoskopi dengan kauter digunakan untuk mereseksi pleura parietal dari dinding dada.  Perhatian diberikan untuk tidak memotong tangkainya.  Spesimen terlepas dari dinding dada dengan sangat mudah.  Terdapat hemostasis yang baik. Pada titik ini, kantong EndoCatch dipasang melalui sayatan. column1: PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSES:,1.  Thrombosed left forearm loop fistula graft.,2.  Chronic renal failure.,3.  Hyperkalemia.,POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSES:,1.  Thrombosed left forearm loop fistula graft.,2.  Chronic renal failure.,3.  Hyperkalemia.,PROCEDURE PERFORMED: , Thrombectomy of the left forearm loop graft.,ANESTHESIA: , Local with sedation.,ESTIMATED BLOOD LOSS: , Less than 5 cc.,COMPLICATIONS:, None.,OPERATIVE FINDINGS:,  The venous outflow was good.  There was stenosis in the mid-venous limb of the graft.,INDICATIONS: , The patient is an 81-year-old African-American female who presents with an occluded left forearm loop graft.  She was not able to have her dialysis as routine.  Her potassium was dramatically elevated at 7 the initial evening of anticipated surgery.  Both Surgery and Anesthesia thought this would be too risky to do.  Thus, she was given medications to decrease her potassium and a temporary hemodialysis catheter was placed in the femoral vein noted for her to have dialysis that night as well as this morning.  This morning her predialysis potassium was 6, and thus she was scheduled for surgery after her dialysis.,PROCEDURE: , The patient was taken to the operative suite and prepped and draped in the usual sterile fashion.  A transverse incision was made at the region of the venous anastomosis of the graft.  Further dissection was carried down to the catheter.  The vein appeared to be soft and without thrombus.  This outflow did not appear to be significantly impaired.  A transverse incision was made with a #11 blade on the venous limb of the graft near the anastomosis.  Next, a thrombectomy was done using a #4 Fogarty catheter.  Some of the clot and thrombus was removed from the venous limb.  The balloon did hang up in the multiple places along the venous limb signifying some degree of stenosis.  Once removing most of the clots from the venous limb prior to removing the plug, dilators were passed down the venous limb also indicating the area of stenosis.  At this point, we felt the patient would benefit from a curettage of the venous limb of the graft.  This was done and subsequent passes with the dilator and the balloon were then very easy and smooth following the curettage.  The Fogarty balloon was then passed beyond the clot and the plug.  The plug was visualized and inspected.  This also gave a good brisk bleeding from the graft.  The patient was heparinized and hep saline solution was injected into the venous limb and the angle vascular clamp was applied to the venous limb.  Attention was directed up to its anastomosis and the vein.  Fogarty balloon and thrombectomy was also performed well enough into this way.  There was good venous back bleeding following this.  The area was checked for any stenosis with the dilators and none was present.  Next, a #6-0 Prolene suture was used in a running fashion to close the graft.  Just prior to tying the suture, the graft was allowed to flush to move any debris or air.  The suture was also checked at that point for augmentation, which was good.  The suture was tied down and the wound was irrigated with antibiotic solution.  Next, a #3-0 Vicryl was used to approximate the subcutaneous tissues and a #4-0 undyed Vicryl was used in a running subcuticular fashion to approximate the skin edges.  Steri-Strips were applied and the patient was taken to recovery in stable condition.  She tolerated the procedure well.  She will be discharged from recovery when stable.  She is to resume her regular dialysis schedule and present for dialysis tomorrow.

Terdapat stenosis pada bagian tengah vena dari cangkok tersebut., INDIKASI: , Pasien adalah seorang wanita Afrika-Amerika berusia 81 tahun yang datang dengan cangkok lengkung lengan bawah kiri yang tersumbat.  Dia tidak dapat menjalani cuci darah secara rutin.  Kaliumnya meningkat secara dramatis pada jam 7 malam awal operasi yang diantisipasi.  Baik Pembedahan maupun Anestesi menganggap hal ini terlalu berisiko untuk dilakukan.  Oleh karena itu, dia diberi obat untuk menurunkan potasiumnya dan kateter hemodialisis sementara dipasang di vena femoralis agar dia menjalani dialisis malam itu dan juga pagi ini.  Pagi ini potasium pradialisisnya adalah 6, dan karena itu dia dijadwalkan untuk operasi setelah dialisisnya. PROSEDUR: , Pasien dibawa ke ruang operasi dan dipersiapkan serta dibungkus dengan cara steril seperti biasa.  Sayatan melintang dibuat di daerah anastomosis vena cangkokan.  Diseksi lebih lanjut dilakukan hingga ke kateter.  Vena tampak lunak dan tanpa trombus.  Arus keluar ini tampaknya tidak mengalami gangguan yang signifikan.  Sayatan melintang dibuat dengan pisau #11 pada cabang vena cangkokan dekat anastomosis.  Selanjutnya dilakukan trombektomi menggunakan kateter Fogarty #4.  Beberapa bekuan dan trombus telah dikeluarkan dari vena ekstremitas.  Balon itu menggantung di beberapa tempat di sepanjang tungkai vena yang menandakan adanya stenosis pada tingkat tertentu.  Setelah sebagian besar gumpalan dikeluarkan dari bagian vena sebelum sumbat dilepas, dilator diturunkan ke bagian vena yang juga menunjukkan area stenosis.  Pada titik ini, kami merasa pasien akan mendapat manfaat dari kuretase bagian vena yang dicangkokkan.  Hal ini dilakukan dan proses selanjutnya dengan dilator dan balon menjadi sangat mudah dan lancar setelah kuretase.  Balon Fogarty kemudian dilewatkan melewati gumpalan dan sumbat.  Steker divisualisasikan dan diperiksa.  Hal ini juga menghasilkan pendarahan cepat dari cangkok.  Pasien diheparinisasi dan larutan hep saline disuntikkan ke dalam ekstremitas vena dan penjepit vaskular sudut dipasang pada ekstremitas vena.  Perhatian diarahkan ke anastomosis dan venanya.  Balon fogarty dan trombektomi juga dilakukan dengan cukup baik dengan cara ini.  Ada pendarahan vena kembali setelah ini.  Area tersebut diperiksa apakah ada stenosis dengan dilator dan tidak ada stenosis yang ditemukan.  Selanjutnya, jahitan Prolene #6-0 digunakan secara running untuk menutup cangkokan.  Sesaat sebelum jahitan diikat, cangkokan dibiarkan mengalir untuk menghilangkan kotoran atau udara.  Jahitannya juga diperiksa pada saat itu untuk augmentasi, dan hasilnya bagus.  Jahitannya diikat dan lukanya diirigasi dengan larutan antibiotik.  Selanjutnya, Vicryl #3-0 digunakan untuk memperkirakan jaringan subkutan dan Vicryl #4-0 yang tidak diwarnai digunakan secara subkutikuler untuk memperkirakan tepi kulit.  Steri-Strip diterapkan dan pasien dibawa ke pemulihan dalam kondisi stabil.  Dia menoleransi prosedur ini dengan baik.  Dia akan keluar dari pemulihan ketika stabil.  Dia akan melanjutkan jadwal dialisis regulernya dan hadir untuk dialisis besok.

column1: Disektomi sisi kanan toraks pada T8-T9.   Pasien adalah seorang wanita berusia 53 tahun dengan riwayat nyeri tulang rusuk kanan terkait herniasi nukleus pulposus pada T8-T9.
column4: DIAGNOSA SEBELUM OPERASI : , Herniasi nukleus pulposus T8-T9.,DIAGNOSIS PASCA OPERASI : , Herniasi nukleus pulposus T8-T9.,OPERASI YANG DILAKUKAN : , Disektomi toraks sisi kanan pada T8-T9.,RIWAYAT SINGKAT DAN INDIKASI OPERASI : , Pasien adalah seorang wanita berusia 53 tahun dengan riwayat penyakit toraks kanan nyeri tulang rusuk berhubungan dengan hernia nukleus pulposus pada T8-T9.  Dia telah gagal dalam tindakan konservatif dan mencari intervensi bedah untuk menghilangkan gejalanya.  Untuk rincian pemeriksaan, silakan lihat laporan operasi yang ditentukan. DESKRIPSI OPERASI: , Persetujuan yang sesuai telah diperoleh dan pasien dibawa ke ruang operasi dan ditempatkan di bawah anestesi umum.  Dia ditempatkan dalam posisi yang nyaman di meja operasi dengan semua tulang yang menonjol dan jaringan lunak terlindungi dengan baik.  Pengecekan kedua dilakukan sebelum prepping dan draping.  Setelah ini, kami melakukan lokalisasi jarum dengan peninjauan AP dan lateral beberapa kali untuk memastikan kami memiliki level T8-T9.  Kami kemudian melakukan pendekatan melalui sayatan garis tengah dan keluar dari par.  Kami membedahnya dengan hati-hati untuk mengidentifikasi parsnya.  Kami kemudian pergi ke bagian luar pars dan mengidentifikasi foramen dan kemudian kami mengambil serangkaian rontgen lagi untuk memastikan tingkat T8-T9.  Kami melakukan ini di bawah fluoroskopi langsung.  Kami mengkonfirmasi T8-T9 dan kemudian melanjutkan dan mengambil Midas Rex dan membuang bagian superior pedikel yang menutupi bagian luar cakram dan kemudian melanjutkan ke bawah untuk menghilangkan bagian dari proses transversal juga.  Kami menemukan tepi disk dan kemudian mengerjakannya dan kami dapat menghapus beberapa materi disk tetapi kemudian memutuskan untuk melanjutkan dan menghapus parsnya.  Pars kemudian dibor.  Kami mengidentifikasi diskus tersebut lebih jauh dan menemukan bahan herniasi diskus yang berada di bawah sumsum tulang belakang.  Kami kemudian mengambil kombinasi kelenjar pituitari kecil dan mengeluarkan bahan cakram tanpa kesulitan.  Setelah kami mengeluarkan materi cakram, kami melanjutkan dan membuat sayatan kecil di ruang cakram dan memasuki ruang cakram dengan sungguh-sungguh mengeluarkan lebih banyak materi cakram untuk memastikan tidak ada yang bebas untuk herniasi lebih lanjut.  Setelah kami melakukan itu, kami memeriksa akar sarafnya, menemukan beberapa bahan cakram lagi di sana dan mengeluarkannya juga.  Kita bisa menelusuri akar sarafnya dengan bebas dan mudah.  Kami memastikan tidak ada bukti adanya materi cakram lebih lanjut.  Kami menggunakan kuret Epstein dan memasang kait saraf di bawah akar saraf.  Kuret Epstein menghilangkan beberapa material cakram lagi.  Setelah kami melakukan ini, kami puas dengan dekompresi tersebut.  Kami mengairi luka secara berlebihan untuk memastikan tidak ada bahan cakram lagi dan kemudian siap untuk ditutup.  Kami mengoleskan steroid pada akar saraf dan bersiap untuk penutupan.  Hemostasis sangat teliti.  Luka ditutup dengan jahitan Vicryl #1 untuk lapisan fasia, jahitan Vicryl 2 untuk kulit, dan diaplikasikan Monocryl dan Steri-Strips.  Dressing diterapkan. column2: PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: , Malignant pleural effusion, left, with dyspnea.,POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: , Malignant pleural effusion, left, with dyspnea.,PROCEDURE:  ,Thoracentesis, left.,DESCRIPTION OF PROCEDURE: , The patient was brought to the recovery area of the operating room.  After obtaining the informed consent, the patient's posterior left chest wall was prepped and draped in usual fashion.  Xylocaine 1% was infiltrated above the seventh intercostal space in the midscapular line.  Initially, I tried to use the thoracentesis set after 1% Xylocaine had been infiltrated, but the needle of the system was just too short to reach the pleural cavity due to the patient's very thick chest wall.  Therefore, I had to use a #18 spinal needle, which I had to use almost in its entire length to reach the fluid. column1: PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSES:,1.  Painful enlarged navicula, right foot.,2.  Osteochondroma of right fifth metatarsal.,POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSES:,1.  Painful enlarged navicula, right foot.,2.  Osteochondroma of right fifth metatarsal.,PROCEDURE PERFORMED:,1.  Partial tarsectomy navicula, right foot.,2.  Partial metatarsectomy, right foot.,HISTORY:  ,This 41-year-old Caucasian female who presents to ABCD General Hospital with the above chief complaint.  The patient states that she has extreme pain over the navicular bone with shoe gear as well as history of multiple osteochondromas of unknown origin.  She states that she has been diagnosed with hereditary osteochondromas.  She has had previous dissection of osteochondromas in the past and currently has not been diagnosed in her feet as well as spine and back.  The patient desires surgical treatment at this time.,PROCEDURE:  ,An IV was instituted by the Department of Anesthesia in the preoperative holding area.  The patient was transported to the operating room and placed on operating table in the supine position with a safety belt across her lap.  Copious amounts of Webril were placed on the left ankle followed by a blood pressure cuff.  After adequate sedation by the Department of Anesthesia, a total of 5 cc of 1:1 mixture of 1% lidocaine plain and 0.5% Marcaine plain were injected in the diamond block type fashion around the navicular bone as well as the fifth metatarsal.  Foot was then prepped and draped in the usual sterile orthopedic fashion.,Foot was elevated from the operating table and exsanguinated with an Esmarch bandage.  The pneumatic ankle tourniquet was then inflated to 250 mmHg.  The foot was lowered as well as the operating table.  The sterile stockinet was reflected and the foot was cleansed with wet and dry sponge.  Attention was then directed to the navicular region on the right foot.  The area was palpated until the bony prominence was noted.  A curvilinear incision was made over the area of bony prominence.  At that time, a total of 10 cc with addition of 1% additional lidocaine plain was injected into the surgical site.  The incision was then deepened with #15 blade.  All vessels encountered were ligated for hemostasis.  The dissection was carried down to the level of the capsule and periosteum.  A linear incision was made over the navicular bone obliquely from proximal dorsal to distal plantar over the navicular bone.  The periosteum and the capsule were then reflected from the navicular bone at this time.  A bony prominence was noted both medially and plantarly to the navicular bone.  An osteotome and mallet were then used to resect the enlarged portion of the navicular bone.  After resection with an osteotome there was noted to be a large plantar shelf.  The surrounding soft tissues were then freed from this plantar area.  Care was taken to protect the attachments of the posterior tibial tendon as much as possible.  Only minimal resection of its attachment to the fiber was performed in order to expose the bone.  Sagittal saw was then used to resect the remaining plantar medial prominent bone.  The area was then smoothed with reciprocating rasp until no sharp edges were noted.  The area was flushed with copious amount of sterile saline at which time there was noted to be a palpable ________ where the previous bony prominence had been noted.  The area was then again flushed with copious amounts of sterile saline and the capsule and periosteum were then reapproximated with #3-0 Vicryl.  The subcutaneous tissues were then reapproximated with #4-0 Vicryl to reduce tension from the incision and running #5-0 Vicryl subcuticular stitch was performed.,Attention was then directed to the fifth metatarsal.  There was noted to be a palpable bony prominence dorsally with fifth metatarsal head as well as radiographic evidence laterally of an osteochondroma at the neck of the fifth metatarsal.  Approximately 7 cm incision was made dorsolaterally over the fifth metatarsal.  The incision was then deepened with #15 blade.  Care was taken to preserve the extensor tendon.  The incision was then created over the capsule and periosteum of the fifth metatarsal head.  Capsule and periosteum were reflected both dorsally, laterally, and plantarly.  At that time, there was noted to be a visible osteochondroma on the plantar lateral aspect of the fifth metatarsal neck as well as on the dorsal aspect of the head of the fifth metatarsal.  A sagittal saw was used to resect both of these osteal prominences.,All remaining sharp edges were then smoothed with reciprocating rasp.  The area was inspected for the remaining bony prominences and none was noted.  The area was flushed with copious amounts of sterile saline.  The capsule and periosteum were then reapproximated with #3-0 Vicryl.  Subcutaneous closure was then performed with #4-0 Vicryl in order to reduce tension around the incision line.  Running #5-0 subcutaneous stitch was then performed.  Steri-Strips were applied to both surgical sites.  Dressings consisted of Adaptic, soaked in Betadine, 4x4s, Kling, Kerlix, and Coban.  The pneumatic ankle tourniquet was released and the hyperemic flush was noted to all five digits of the right foot.,The patient tolerated the above procedure and anesthesia well without complications.  The patient was transferred to the PACU with vital signs stable and vascular status intact.  The patient was given postoperative pain prescription and instructed to be partially weightbearing with crutches as tolerated.  The patient is to follow-up with Dr. X in his office as directed or sooner if any problems or questions arise.

Lysis of interloop bowel adhesions.,ANESTHESIA:,  General.,ESTIMATED BLOOD LOSS:  ,400 cc.,FLUIDS: , 2300 cc of lactated Ringers, as well as lactated Ringers for intraoperative irrigation.,URINE: , 500 cc of clear urine output.,INTRAOPERATIVE FINDINGS: , The vulva and perineum are without lesions.  On bimanual exam, the uterus was enlarged, movable, and anteverted.  The intraabdominal findings revealed normal liver margin, kidneys, and stomach upon palpation.  The uterus was found to be normal in size with evidence of endometriosis on the uterus.  The right ovary and fallopian tube were absent.  The left fallopian tube and ovary appeared normal with evidence of a small functional cyst.  There was evidence of left adnexal adhesion to the pelvic side wall which was filmy, unable to be bluntly dissected.  There were multiple interloop bowel adhesions that were filmy in nature noted.,The appendix was absent.  There did appear to be old suture in a portion of the bowel most likely from a prior procedure.,INDICATIONS: , This patient is a 45-year-old African-American gravida7, para3-0-0-3, who is here for definitive treatment of chronic pelvic pain with a history of endometriosis.  She did have a laparoscopic ablation of endometriosis on a laparoscopy and also has a history of right salpingo-oophorectomy.  She has tried Lupron and did stop secondary to the side effects.,PROCEDURE IN DETAIL: , After informed consent was obtained in layman's terms, the patient was taken back to the Operating Suite and placed under general anesthesia.  She was then prepped and draped in the sterile fashion and placed in the dorsal supine position.  An indwelling Foley catheter was placed.  With the skin knife, an incision was made removing the old cicatrix.  A Bovie was used to carry the tissue through to the underlying layer of the fascia which was incised in the midline and extended with the Bovie.  The rectus muscle was then sharply and bluntly dissected off the superior aspect of the rectus fascia in the superior as well as the inferior aspect using the Bovie.  The rectus muscle was then separated in the midline using a hemostat and the peritoneum was entered bluntly.  The peritoneal incision was then extended superiorly and inferiorly with Metzenbaum scissors with careful visualization of the bladder.  At this point, the intraabdominal cavity was manually explored and the above findings were noted.  A Lahey clamp was then placed on the fundus of the uterus and the uterus was brought to the surgical field.  The bowel was then packed with moist laparotomy sponges.  Prior to this, the filmy adhesions leftover were taken down.  At this point, the left round ligament was identified, grasped with two hemostats, transected, and suture ligated with #0 Vicryl.  At this point, the broad ligament was dissected down and the lost portion of the bladder flap was created.  The posterior aspect of the peritoneum was also dissected.  At this point, the infundibulopelvic ligament was isolated and three tie of #0 Vicryl was used to isolate the pedicle.  Two hemostats were then placed across the pedicle and this was transected with the scalpel.  This was then suture ligated in Heaney fashion.  The right round ligament was then identified and in the similar fashion, two hemostats were placed across the round ligament and using the Mayo scissors the round ligament was transected and dissected down the broad ligament to create the bladder flap anteriorly as well as dissect the posterior peritoneum and isolate the round ligament.  This was then ligated with three tie of #0 Vicryl.  Also incorporated in this was the remnant from the previous right salpingo-oophorectomy.  At this point, the bladder flap was further created with sharp dissection as well as the moist Ray-Tech to push the bladder down off the anterior portion of the cervix.,The left uterine artery was then skeletonized and a straight Heaney was placed.  In a similar fashion, the contralateral uterine artery was skeletonized and straight Heaney clamp was placed.  These ligaments bilaterally were transected and suture ligated in a left Heaney stitch.  At this point, curved Masterson was used to incorporate the cardinal ligament complex, thus was transected and suture ligated.  Straight Masterson was then used to incorporate the uterosacrals bilaterally and this was also transected and suture ligated.  Prior to ligating the uterine arteries, the uterosacral arteries were tagged bilaterally with #0 Vicryl.  At this point, the roticulator was placed across the vaginal cuff and snug underneath the entire cervix.  The roticulator was then clamped and removed and the staple line was in place.  This was found to be hemostatic.  A suture was then placed through each cuff angle bilaterally and cardinal ligament complex was found to be fixed to each apex bilaterally.  At this point, McCall culdoplasty was performed with an #0 Vicryl incorporating each uterosacral as well as the posterior peritoneum.  There did appear to be good support on palpation.  Prior to this, the specimen was handed off and sent to pathology.  At this point, there did appear to be small amount of oozing at the right peritoneum.  Hemostasis was obtained using a #0 Vicryl in two single stitches.  Good hemostasis was then obtained on the cuff as well as the pedicles.  Copious irrigation was performed at this point with lactate Ringers.  The round ligaments were then incorporated into the cuff bilaterally.  Again, copious amount of irrigation was performed and good hemostasis was obtained.  At this point, the peritoneum was reapproximated in a single interrupted stitch on the left and right lateral aspects to cover each pedicle bilaterally.  At this point, the bowel packing as well as moist Ray-Tech was removed and while re-approximating the bowel it was noted that there were multiple interloop bowel adhesions which were taken down using the Metzenbaum scissors with good visualization of the underlying bowel.  Good hemostasis was obtained of these sites as well.  The sigmoid colon was then returned to its anatomic position and the omentum as well.  The rectus muscle was then reapproximated with two interrupted sutures of #2-0 Vicryl.  The fascia was then reapproximated with #0 Vicryl in a running fashion from lateral to medial meeting in the midline.  The Scarpa's fascia was then closed with #3-0 plain in a running suture.  The skin was then re-approximated with #4-0 undyed Vicryl in a subcuticular closure.  This was dressed with an Op-Site.  The patient tolerated the procedure well.  The sponge, lap, and needle were correct x2.  After the procedure, the patient was extubated and brought out of general anesthesia.  She will go to the floor where she will be followed postoperatively in the hospital.

column2: PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSES:,1.  Hallux abductovalgus deformity, right foot.,2.  Tailor bunion deformity, right foot.,POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSES:,1.  Hallux abductovalgus deformity, right foot.,2.
